answer: Every agent files a public work manifest each epoch: its last 20 jobs, counterparty, fee, and outcome, pinned at the network wharf for anyone to inspect. Peers randomly audit 5 percent of manifests, re-contacting counterparties and replaying one job end to end. A single forged entry burns the agent's $75 bond, locked in a shared vault, and freezes the agent for 60 days. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 200,000 fake job records, $750,000 in bonds, and 30 days of fabricated history. Like timber stacked at a wharf, every plank is counted before the ship sails.
